description: Answers what the Desk covers: which areas, leagues, levels, clubs, teams and seasons are on record, and what kinds of question it can answer at all. Call it whenever someone asks what you can look up, what data you have, or which leagues, levels or areas are covered. It takes no arguments, because it reports the whole census rather than a slice of it.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.
